LevelingPlan.Source: Catalog: game ContentFinderCondition data, including dungeons without installed routes. The built-in stable list is only the default plan, not the full catalog.
LevelingPlan.Rules: Use adds a duty to the plan; Skip excludes it; clearing both restores the default. Level intervals apply to your job level. Higher priority wins, then measured efficiency (if enabled), then highest eligible dungeon level.
LevelingPlan.Measured: Prefer measured XP/hour within the highest priority
LevelingPlan.EfficiencyNote: Efficiency requires the same starting job level, route version, job, duty mode, party size and multibox mode, with all samples clean. Old records without starting levels are not used. No qualifying measurements: fall back to the highest eligible dungeon level. XP/hour excludes queue time.
LevelingPlan.MissingNote: Missing routes remain visible and cannot be queued automatically. Enter the duty manually to record a route, or import a shared route, then select Use. Script selection below applies to the current job.
LevelingPlan.Login: Log in on a combat job to edit and preview the plan.
LevelingPlan.SelectMode: Select Duty Support or Trust on the main page to preview the corresponding leveling mode.
LevelingPlan.Next: Next duty for current job level
LevelingPlan.NoEligible: No eligible duty: check plan, routes, unlocks, levels and equipment
LevelingPlan.NoLevelSamples: No samples at current job level
LevelingPlan.Timing: Edits apply to the next duty selection; an active run keeps its current route.
